source.feature: First 10 seconds, rebuilt: hook + motion graphics + sound
source.summary: Same 45-second SwitchYard cut rendered in two of the approved styles so you can compare. Pick a favourite (or tell me what to change); S2 editorial and S4 podcast are built into the renderer too.

outputs.notes: Hook scored 69 (ig-reel hookscore). 6 real AI tabs collapse into one on "one" · face card springs split ↔ full · rows hide on clicks · layout fans out to sub-accounts · "Here's how ↓". CC0 SFX + Mixkit bed ducked under voice, -16.3 LUFS. Music licence: re-confirm before posting.

Ref: saraev reels. Light bg, screen card top, rounded face card bottom, one-word captions on the seam, accent words italic serif blue, full-face punch-ins, chapter headers, glowing "LAYOUT" end. 20 shots / 45 s (~2.2 s each).
Ref: leadgenman. Dark green, headline + accent per beat, screen panel swaps every ~2 s, continuous face, 3-word captions. 24 shots / 45 s.
S1 split explainer, S2 editorial, S3 motion header (green/warm), S4 podcast letterbox, S5 POV text, S6 raw vs edited.
